protocol.measure: Confirm the existing local finding with a contiguous run above the flanks at the original tile. Both edges must step by at least half of the median core signal above the background. The first trial is development for this stricter gate.
protocol.held: Take the next eight eligible archived CREMA-D groups after the first trial. Use the same native decode and clocks but fresh edit positions and durations. Exact source intervals are known before encoding. The same redraws are diagnostic with prior exposure.
protocol.gate: The earlier gate applies to newly authored clips with at least twelve exact refinements and six gains across at least four distinct groups. Require at least two retained neural redraws with reduced endpoint error across at least two distinct source groups, including one independently timing-qualified. Preserve no neutral findings, wrong-source rejection, median neural error, and spatial support.
